texto: I explore data, user signals and market context until I can state the problem clearly. What comes out of it becomes ideas that set the direction, support decisions and give the project a solid foundation.
This is where I bring order: information architecture, user flows and design system. The goal is a product that is easy to use, easy to maintain and able to grow without being rebuilt.
I prototype to see what works and what doesn't. I put it in front of the people who will use it and refine the details with what I learn before handing it over to development.
What reaches production has to meet the standard. I lead the QA process and review the details so the experience is consistent and reliable, not just in Figma.
